title: Add continuity tables to database models
description:
Modify chatbot/db/models.py to add TimelineEntry and Ritual tables and a narrative_threads table for the continuity package. Do NOT modify any existing tables.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- docs/architecture.md
- chatbot/db/models.py (existing model conventions — understand the base class, column style, table naming, and import patterns)
- chatbot/continuity/timeline.py (created by task c.1)
- chatbot/continuity/rituals.py (created by task c.3)

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY chatbot/db/models.py. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed path. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed file modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.

Implementation details:

1. Locate the existing SQLAlchemy model classes in chatbot/db/models.py. Inspect the declarative base class, column conventions (snake_case, types, nullable, default, server_default patterns), import list, and table naming style.

2. Add a `TimelineEntry` model class with these columns, matching existing conventions:
   - id: Column(String(64), primary_key=True) — stores the uuid4 entry_id.
   - session_id: Column(String(64), nullable=False, index=True).
   - entry_type: Column(String(20), nullable=False) — 'milestone', 'emotional_event', 'promise', 'running_project'.
   - title: Column(String(255), nullable=False).
   - description: Column(Text, nullable=False).
   - content: Column(Text, nullable=False).
   - turn_id: Column(String(64), nullable=False).
   - status: Column(String(20), nullable=False, default='active') — 'active', 'resolved', 'broken', 'completed', 'abandoned'.
   - tags: Column(JSON, nullable=True) — list of tag strings.
   - metadata_: Column(JSON, nullable=True) — named metadata_ to avoid shadowing SQLAlchemy metadata.
   - created_at: Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=utcnow).
   - updated_at: Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=utcnow).
   - __tablename__ = 'timeline_entries'.

3. Add a `NarrativeThread` model class with these columns:
   - id: Column(String(64), primary_key=True).
   - session_id: Column(String(64), nullable=False, index=True).
   - label: Column(String(255), nullable=False).
   - turns: Column(JSON, nullable=False) — ordered list of turn_id strings.
   - summary: Column(Text, nullable=False).
   - relevance_score: Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0).
   - created_at: Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=utcnow).
   - last_referenced_at: Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=utcnow).
   - __tablename__ = 'narrative_threads'.

4. Add a `Ritual` model class with these columns:
   - id: Column(String(64), primary_key=True).
   - session_id: Column(String(64), nullable=False, index=True).
   - name: Column(String(255), nullable=False).
   - ritual_type: Column(String(20), nullable=False).
   - description: Column(Text, nullable=False).
   - schedule_description: Column(String(255), nullable=False).
   - last_triggered_at: Column(DateTime, nullable=True).
   - next_trigger_at: Column(DateTime, nullable=True).
   - is_active: Column(Boolean, nullable=False, default=True).
   - trigger_prompt: Column(Text, nullable=True).
   - metadata_: Column(JSON, nullable=True).
   - created_at: Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=utcnow).
   - __tablename__ = 'rituals'.

5. All three tables must use the existing declarative base, import Column from the same sqlalchemy import used by existing models, and follow the same table-naming convention. Do NOT change any existing table or column definition.
acceptance_criteria: chatbot/db/models.py defines TimelineEntry model with all specified columns and __tablename__ = 'timeline_entries'
chatbot/db/models.py defines NarrativeThread model with all specified columns and __tablename__ = 'narrative_threads'
chatbot/db/models.py defines Ritual model with all specified columns and __tablename__ = 'rituals'
Existing Memory, Conversation, Turn, or any prior model classes are unmodified
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified

remove or rename the pgvector embedding column
add database indexes, constraints, or foreign keys beyond what is specified

use Column, String, Text, Float, Boolean, DateTime, JSON from the existing sqlalchemy import
use utcnow default for DateTime columns matching existing pattern
